baselines.package.json:
{
  "name": "UniSphere_cor",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "workspaces": {
    "packages": [
      "apps/*",
      "packages/*"
    ],
    "catalog": {
      "dotenv": "^17.4.2",
      "zod": "^4.4.3",
      "typescript": "^6.0.3",
      "@types/bun": "^1.4.0",
      "vitest": "4.1.8",
      "@vitest/ui": "4.1.8",
      "@vitest/coverage-v8": "4.1.8",
      "jsdom": "^29.1.1",
      "@tanstack/react-form": "^1.33.0",
      "react": "19.2.8",
      "react-dom": "19.2.8",
      "@tanstack/react-query": "^5.101.4",
      "zustand": "^5.0.15",
      "socket.io-client": "^4.8.3",
      "motion": "^12.43.0",
      "@types/react": "^19.2.18",
      "@prisma/client": "6.19.0"
    }
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "turbo dev",
    "build": "turbo build",
    "check-types": "turbo check-types",
    "dev:web": "turbo -F web dev",
    "dev:native": "turbo -F native dev",
    "dev:server": "turbo -F server dev",
    "db:push": "turbo -F @UniSphere_cor/db db:push",
    "db:studio": "turbo -F @UniSphere_cor/db db:studio",
    "db:generate": "turbo -F @UniSphere_cor/db db:generate",
    "db:migrate": "turbo -F @UniSphere_cor/db db:migrate",
    "db:start": "turbo -F @UniSphere_cor/db db:start",
    "db:watch": "turbo -F @UniSphere_cor/db db:watch",
    "db:stop": "turbo -F @UniSphere_cor/db db:stop",
    "db:down": "turbo -F @UniSphere_cor/db db:down",
    "test": "bun run --filter web test && bun run --filter server test"
  },
  "packageManager": "bun@1.3.5",
  "dependencies": {
    "dotenv": "catalog:",
    "zod": "catalog:",
    "@UniSphere_cor/env": "workspace:*"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "typescript": "catalog:",
    "@types/bun": "catalog:",
    "@UniSphere_cor/config": "workspace:*",
    "turbo": "2.10.11"
  }
}
